title: Few-Shot Demonstrations Elicit the Use of In-Context World Representations in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.24352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs), when acting as agents, are expected to take observed data in context, infer the latent state space underlying the world, and leverage it for downstream prediction. However, prior work demonstrated that LLMs struggle to use representations learned in context on a graph tracking task, where the model needs to construct a representation of the graph governing data generation process and use it for subsequent predictions. In this paper, we show that extending this to few-shot settings, where each demonstration is generated from a different world with either the same or different graph topologies, enhances its prediction on 6 models from 4 model families. To understand this improvement, we linearly probe a low-dimensional world representation that encodes graph information in the hidden states. Notably, we find that few-shot demonstrations relocate the world representation and increase its predictive use. Specifi

translated_title: 少样本演示激发大语言模型使用上下文世界表征
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在作为智能体行动时，需要根据上下文中观察到的数据，推断世界背后的潜在状态空间，并将其用于下游预测。然而，先前的研究表明，LLM 在图追踪任务中难以使用在上下文中学习到的表征，在该任务中，模型需要构建一个关于数据生成过程所遵循的图的表征，并将其用于后续预测。在本文中，我们表明，将此扩展到少样本设置——其中每个演示都由一个不同的世界生成，这些世界具有相同或不同的图拓扑结构——能够提升来自 4 个模型家族的 6 个模型的预测性能。为了理解这一改进，我们对隐藏状态中编码图信息的低维世界表征进行了线性探测。值得注意的是，我们发现少样本演示会重新定位世界表征并增加其预测用途。
tldr: 少样本演示能够激发大语言模型在图追踪任务中构建并利用上下文世界表征，从而显著提升其预测性能。
en_tdlr: Few-shot demonstrations elicit LLMs to construct and utilize in-context world representations, significantly improving their prediction performance on graph tracking tasks.
